dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: If that happens, the first thing to do is stay calm.

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: Snezhnayan trains have been running across this frozen land for at least four hundred years. We've dealt with just about every situation imaginable, and every conductor is trained for emergencies.

dialogues.speaker: Baryatinsky
dialogues.text: If it comes to that, please trust our judgment.
